sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model has 3B active parameters and 30B parameters in total. This model is ready for commercial use. Quick Start For running Nemotron 3.5 Lightning fast — with NVFP4 quantization, W4A16 for broad hardware coverage, and the DSpark recipe for DGX Spark — please see: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4

sources.snippet: Use Case NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16 is the full-precision release of a general purpose reasoning and chat model, and is intended primarily for customization and post-training rather than direct production inference.
